<plan>1. Move onto the grassy tile by moving north from the current square. 2. While still facing north, place a table in front (which will be the tile north of the new grassy square). This completes the Place Table achievement and sets up the table needed for all tool crafting actions.<plan>
Move North

<plan>1. Do to collect more wood (increases wood for crafting).  
2. Make Wood Sword with the nearby table and current wood.  
3. Move East (step closer to the table and possible creature locations).  
4. Move North (now adjacent to the table for future crafting).  
5. Move East/West to position ourselves near the cow (4 steps southwest).  
6. Move South until we face the cow, then Do to eat the cow (Earn Eat Cow).  
7. With the wood sword, move towards any visible zombie or skeleton; Do to defeat them each (Earn Defeat Zombie and Defeat Skeleton).  
8. Search for a stone block (Do on it to collect stone, then Earn Collect Stone).  
9. Place Stone in front of the table (Earn Place Stone).  
10. Find and Do on a sampling tile (Earn Collect Sampling).  
11. Find and Do on a lake tile to drink water (Earn Collect Drink).  
12. Build a furnace near the table using Place Furnace (Earn Place Furnace).  
13. Gather coal and iron (Do on their tiles).  
14. Make Iron Pickaxe with the furnace, wood, coal, and iron (Earn Make Iron Pickaxe).  
15. Mine a diamond block with the iron pickaxe (Do on diamond ore, Earn Collect Diamond).  
16. Make Iron Sword (Earn Make Iron Sword).  
17. If energy falls below maximum, Sleep.  
18. Repeat crafting steps until all listed achievements are earned.  
19. Confirm Wake Up or Sleep as needed.  
20. Finish with all achievements completed.<plan>
